material.description: blocked_by: mod-hot-reload-rollback. gm-eliminate could not run a live check locally (orchestrator scope forbids local cargo build). Open unknowns U1 (advance applies staged reload before on_tick), U2 (syntax error gives ReloadError line), U3 (osdt-data must be a normal dependency for a bin), U4 (set_modified makes reload see the edit). Their only instrument is the pushed harness run in ci.yml, but gm-edit refuses to start with unknowns open, so the edit that creates the instrument cannot land. Decision needed: authorise publishing the harness as a CI probe before the unknowns close, or allow CI-only closure of these four unknowns. Receipts: .gm/receipts/mod-hot-reload-rollback/01-orient.md, 03-eliminate.md.
